name: cf-tunnel
title: Cloudflare Tunnel
description: Manage Cloudflare NAMED tunnels (token/name → hostname list), routes and DNS. Subcommands: config / status / tunnels / sync / create / rm / list / add / del.
author: cicy-ai

zh-CN.title: Cloudflare Tunnel
zh-CN.description: 管理 Cloudflare 具名隧道(token/name → 域名列表)、路由和 DNS。子命令:config / status / tunnels / sync / create / rm / list / add / del。

tools.name: cf-tunnel tunnels
tools.description: Tree of named tunnels → their hostnames (live from CF API)

tools.name: cf-tunnel sync
tools.description: Regenerate <env>.tunnels {id, token, hostnames[]} in ~/cicy-ai/db/cf-tunnel.json from the CF API

tools.name: cf-tunnel create
tools.description: Provision a named tunnel end-to-end (tunnel + ingress + DNS + connector token → registry)

tools.name: cf-tunnel rm
tools.description: Delete a named tunnel, its DNS records and its registry entry

tools.name: cf-tunnel status
tools.description: Check config state and registered tunnel names

tools.name: cf-tunnel list
tools.description: (legacy) List all routes of the fixed tunnel_id

tools.name: cf-tunnel del
tools.description: (legacy) Remove a <port>.<domain> route and its DNS record (also matches old g-<port>)
